div.head: II As 26
div.ab: Be mansworum. Se ðe mænne aþ swerige, ⁊ hit him on open weorþe, þæt he næfre æþwyrþe ne sy, ne binnan nanum gehalgodum lictune ne licge, ðeah he gefære, butan he hæbbe ðæs bisceopes gewitnysse, ðe he on his scire sy, þæt he hit swa gebete hæbbe, swa his scrift him scrife.

Ond se ðe manað swerige, ⁊ hit him on open wurþe, ðæt he næfre eft aðwyrþe ne sy, ne binnon nanum gehalgodum lictune ne licge, þeah he forðfore, buton he hæbbe ðæs biscopes gewitnesse, ðe he on his scriftscire sy, þæt he hit swa gebet hæbbe, swa him his scrift scrife.

De omnibus periuris. Qui falsum iuramentum iurauerit et conuictus inde fuerit, numquam postea iuramento dignus sit nec in sanctificato atrio aliquo iaceat, si moriatur, nisi (si non) habeat episcopi testimonium, in cuius scira (diocesi) sit, quod penitentiam acceperit.

[Be mansworum.] [Ld] Ond se ðe manað swerige, ⁊ hit him on open wurðe, ðæt he næfre eft æðwyrþe ne sy, ne binnon nanum gehalgodum lictune ne licge, þeah he forðfore, buton he hæbbe ðæs biscopes gewitnesse, ðe he on his scriftscire sy, þæt he hit swa gebet hæbbe, swa him his scrift scrife.

And if anyone swears a false oath and it becomes manifest he has done so, he shall never again have the right to swear an oath; and he shall not be buried in any consecrated burial ground when he dies, unless he has the testimony of the bishop, in whose diocese he is, that he has made such amends as his confessor has prescribed for him.

Und wer Meineid schwört, und [wenn] das über ihn offenbar wird: dass der nimmer wieder eideswürdig sei, noch, wenn er stirbt, innerhalb eines geweihten Friedhofes liege, ausser wenn er des Bischofes Zeugniss hat, in dessen Beichtsprengel er ist, dass er es so gebüsst habe, wie ihm sein Beichtvater Poenitenz auferlegt.

And whoever swears a false oath, and [if] that becomes manifest against him: that he never again be oath-worthy, nor, when he dies, lie within any consecrated graveyard, unless he has the witness of the bishop in whose confessional district he is, that he has made amends for it as his confessor prescribed for him.
